title: Frozen real cross-task validation protocol for inherited-experience triage
research_questions: Does prior identity (copied-global, global-only, contextual) change safe deployment behavior?
Can sparse or conflicting validation evidence be detected before deployment?
Does abstain reduce harmful deployment while retaining candidates for later review?

task_families.name: SearchQA
task_families.notes: Phase 1B test answers are frozen held-out evidence and cannot tune thresholds.

task_families.name: OfficeQA
task_families.notes: Requires authorized materialization of the gated official payload.

task_families.name: SpreadsheetBench
task_families.notes: Requires materialized task JSON and spreadsheet files.

triage_actions.reject: do not deploy candidate; retain for future review
triage_actions.abstain: do not deploy; retain and mark evidence-insufficient or conflicting
triage_actions.discard: never emitted by the validation gate

decision_gate.pass_for_real_pilot: protocol audit passes, payloads are materialized, and no thresholds are tuned on SearchQA held-out answers
decision_gate.pass_for_method_claim: triage reduces harmful deployment on at least one new task family without rejecting nearly all helpful updates and does not lose the frozen MOAR quality advantage
decision_gate.fallback: if triage fails, freeze prior taxonomy plus proxy-to-real mismatch as the paper contribution and demote triage to a safety limitation

required_materialization: data/spreadsheetbench_id_split/val/items.json plus task JSON and spreadsheet files
frozen model endpoint and compliant batch policy
